claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show Honda-branded grille badge and two headlight assemblies; no tailights are shown, and no proof of location/availability in GRA Ikeja is present.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No part numbers, markings, or brand/labeling are shown in the witness report; grille badge appears Honda, not Toyota.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: Witness report notes black mounting brackets/holders are attached, but does not confirm grille cracks or the completeness of all clips/brackets; grille condition details and badge mounting integrity are not visible.
No bulbs/ballasts/wiring connectors are shown and no beam/functional test is shown; witness report only shows headlight assemblies with no bulbs visible.

risks.risk: Item mismatch: witness shows Honda grille badge and headlight assemblies, while seller claims Toyota Prado grille and tailight.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the grille badge/markings and the headlight/tailight part numbers (or VIN/fitment label) plus a photo showing the exact tailight unit if included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching used headlight/grille set with unknown fitment and no confirmed tailight included.

risks.risk: Non-functionality risk: headlights may be missing internal components (bulbs/ballasts/igniters) or have wiring/connector issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear housing openings showing internal components (ballast/igniter), and a short clip of the lights switched on (low/high) with connectors visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/unknown working status.

risks.risk: Lens/reflector degradation: scratches, pitting, or reflector fading can’t be confirmed from the current report.
risks.proof: Macro close-ups of lens surface (front and edges) and reflector surface, plus a photo showing any condensation/moisture inside the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with potential lens/reflector wear.

risks.risk: Mounting damage: tabs/brackets may be bent or broken even if generally attached.
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles focusing on each mounting tab/clip area, showing straightness and any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring possible bracket repair/extra parts.

risks.risk: Aftermarket/clone risk: seller claims original Toyota, but no identifying markings are shown and grille badge appears Honda.
risks.proof: Photo of any OEM stamp/engraving, part number sticker, or manufacturer mark on the back of the headlight/grille, and a clear shot of the grille badge area.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the exact items included: the tailight(s) if you are selling them (not just headlights).
Provide close-ups of part numbers/OEM markings on the headlight(s) and grille (front and back of housings).
Show the rear of the headlight assemblies with connectors and any ballasts/igniters/bulb holders visible.
Send a short video clip switching the headlights on (low and high) to confirm working condition.
Provide close-up photos of the grille for cracks, missing slats, and badge mounting integrity.
response.reason: The witness report shows Honda-branded grille and headlight assemblies, while the seller claims Toyota Prado grille and tailight in working condition. Without proof of exact fitment, included parts (tailights), and functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the current evidence.
